authority: Clay Mathematics Institute Millennium Prize Problems
question: P = NP?

objects.P: languages decided by a deterministic multi-tape Turing machine in time n^{O(1)}
objects.NP: languages with polynomial-time deterministic verifiers, equivalently decided by a nondeterministic TM in time n^{O(1)}

notes: The Clay problem is uniform deterministic polynomial-time computation.
A proof of NP notsubseteq P/poly implies P ≠ NP but is strictly stronger.
Circuit-family lower bounds are not interchangeable with SAT notin P.
legalClosingStatements: SAT notin P in this model
illegalClosingStatements: SAT is hard for current SAT solvers
there exist large circuits for some explicit functions in a restricted class
a Lean theorem whose type is not the Clay statement
